t: Raspberry Pi 5 power shrunk onto a small module for custom gadgets and products.
steps: Buy the Development Kit for Compute Module 5 from a maker shop to get the module, IO board and power supply together.
Fit the module onto the IO board and add a heatsink or cooler.
Install the free Raspberry Pi Imager app on another computer.
Hold the board in USB boot mode and write Raspberry Pi OS to the built-in storage with Imager.
Connect a screen, keyboard, and mouse to the IO board and plug in power.
Follow the setup screens to join Wi-Fi and create your account.
Open Thonny and blink an LED on the IO board pin header with a gpiozero example.
meta: Open Board. From $20. A few stores.
